bibl.title: Roadmap for advanced aqueous batteries: From design of materials to applications

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: aqueous batteries - water-based electrochemical storage - and what stands between them and grid-scale deployment
span.quote: Safety concerns about organic media-based batteries are the key public arguments against their widespread usage. Aqueous batteries (ABs), based on water which is environmentally benign, provide a promising alternative for safe, cost-effective, and scalable energy storage, with high power density and tolerance against mishandling.

span.label: what has to be solved, from material design to commercialisation, before aqueous batteries can replace organic-media ones
span.quote: Research interests and achievements in ABs have surged globally in the past 5 years. However, their large-scale application is plagued by the limited output voltage and inadequate energy density.

span.label: a roadmap that starts at material design and ends at commercialisation, with the challenges of different aqueous systems related to one another
span.quote: Safety concerns about organic media-based batteries are the key public arguments against their widespread usage. Aqueous batteries (ABs), based on water which is environmentally benign, provide a promising alternative for safe, cost-effective, and scalable energy storage, with high power density and tolerance against mishandling.

span.label: method
span.quote: Depending on the nature of migration ions, ABs can be classified into two types: metal-ion ABs and non–metal-ion ABs. So far, a variety of metal-ion ABs, such as Li+, Na+, K+, Zn2+, Mg2+, Ca2+, and Al3+, have been demonstrated on the basis of metal-ion intercalation chemistry.

span.label: ion migration in aqueous electrolyte, safe and cheap, and short of the voltage and energy density the application needs
span.quote: Research interests and achievements in ABs have surged globally in the past 5 years. However, their large-scale application is plagued by the limited output voltage and inadequate energy density.

span.label: critical appraisal of recent advances, organised by charge carrier and by the electrode and electrolyte strategies each one needs
span.term: critical appraisal of recent advances, organised by charge carrier and by the electrode and electrolyte strategies each one needs
span.quote: Depending on the nature of migration ions, ABs can be classified into two types: metal-ion ABs and non–metal-ion ABs. So far, a variety of metal-ion ABs, such as Li+, Na+, K+, Zn2+, Mg2+, Ca2+, and Al3+, have been demonstrated on the basis of metal-ion intercalation chemistry.

span.label: the ionic radius sets which compounds can host the ion: Na+ (0.95 A) and K+ (1.33 A) are much larger than Li+ (0.60 A), which NARROWS THE SELECTION CRITERION to a few compounds capable of de/intercalation in aqueous media
span.quote: However, the radii of Na+ (0.95 Å) and K+ (1.33 Å) are much larger than those of Li+ (0.60 Å) ( Fig. 2A), so the selection criterion was specialized to only a few compounds, showing capability of Na+ or K+ deintercalation/intercalation in aqueous media.

span.label: the HYDRATED radius runs the other way - solvated K+ is smaller, so the electrolyte conducts better and the rate capability is higher for K+ than for Li+ or Na+
span.quote: Because of the smaller hydrated radius of solvated K+ (3.31 Å), KAB-based electrolyte exhibits much higher ionic conductivity, which enables higher rate capability in K+ storage than in Li+ and Na+

span.label: THE LABORATORY-TO-INDUSTRY GAP IS STATED WITH A NUMBER: materials that would need high gravimetric capacity, high rate capability and long life AT HIGH MASS LOADING simultaneously remain difficult to achieve, against an industrial-level areal capacity of about 35 mAh/cm2
span.quote: which is much lower than the industrial-level areal capacity of ∼35 mAh cm−2 ( _79_). Therefore, further developments of Ni-based and Co-based materials for Ni-Zn or Co-Zn batteries, which simultaneously have high gravimetric capacity, high rate capability, and long life with high mass loading, remain difficult to achieve.

span.label: large-scale application is plagued by limited output voltage and inadequate energy density - the two properties the safety argument is traded against
span.quote: Research interests and achievements in ABs have surged globally in the past 5 years. However, their large-scale application is plagued by the limited output voltage and inadequate energy density.

span.label: an explosive growth of publications in five years, with limitations that STILL should be overcome - the paper's own framing of its field's output
span.quote: We have witnessed an explosive growth of publications regarding advanced ABs especially in the recent 5 years, but there are still some limitations that should be overcome.

span.label: energy density, power density and long-standing stability all have to be pushed further before the requirements of practical applications are met
span.quote: Although significant advances have been made in this area, unremitting efforts are still required, including pushing the energy/power densities and long-standing stability before meeting the requirements of practical applications.

span.label: the proposed systems are compared against the incumbents that actually hold the market - LIBs, Ni/MH and lead-acid - rather than against each other
span.note: eliminates: a new chemistry looking good against other new chemistries while losing to the battery already in the product · outcome: held
span.quote: Currently, LIBs, Ni/MH, and lead-acid batteries remain as the mainstream energy storage systems in the world market of rechargeable batteries. LIBs have been the ubiquitous commercial power source for portable electronics, electric vehicles, and backup power supplies as evidenced by their widespread usage in the past decades.

span.label: laboratory areal capacity is stated against the INDUSTRIAL-LEVEL figure rather than against other laboratory results
span.note: eliminates: a record capacity that is a record only among research cells · outcome: failed
span.quote: which is much lower than the industrial-level areal capacity of ∼35 mAh cm−2 ( _79_). Therefore, further developments of Ni-based and Co-based materials for Ni-Zn or Co-Zn batteries, which simultaneously have high gravimetric capacity, high rate capability, and long life with high mass loading, remain difficult to achieve.

span.label: aqueous battery - AS USED HERE: a battery whose electrolyte is water, classified by WHICH ION MIGRATES rather than by anything about its chemistry in the abstract. The defining property is the one the measurement observes, which is why this paper hedges its taxonomy nowhere
span.quote: Depending on the nature of migration ions, ABs can be classified into two types: metal-ion ABs and non–metal-ion ABs. So far, a variety of metal-ion ABs, such as Li+, Na+, K+, Zn2+, Mg2+, Ca2+, and Al3+, have been demonstrated on the basis of metal-ion intercalation chemistry.

span.label: `WISE` / `salt-in-water electrolyte` - A NAME PAIR BUILT BY INVERSION, AND THE OLDER MEMBER IS THE ONE THAT HAD TO BE COINED. `The salt-in-water electrolyte REFERS TO TRADITIONAL AQUEOUS ELECTROLYTE.` The dilute case needed no name until the concentrated case existed; the paper defines it purely by pointing back at the thing it already was.
span.quote: water-in-salt electrolyte (WISE) or hydrate-melt electrolytes. The salt-in-water electrolyte refers to traditional aqueous electrolyte.

span.label: critiques → organic-media lithium-ion batteries, on safety grounds, with dated incidents - Boeing 787 in 2013, Samsung Note 7 in 2016, Tesla Model S in 2019
span.quote: Incidents in recent years include Boeing 787 battery fires in 2013, Samsung Note 7 explosions in 2016, and the Tesla Model S combustions in 2019. These have caused serious threats to human health or life, which remind us continuously that safety is a prerequisite for batteries

span.label: critiques → lithium-based grid storage, on the scarcity of Li at 20 parts per million and its rising cost
span.quote: The scarce abundance (20 parts per million) and increasing high cost of Li (or Co) pose challenges for using them for grid storage.

span.label: WISE —contrasted-with→ salt-in-water electrolyte
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — The contrast is the whole content of the name: the two differ only in which component is in excess.
span.quote: water-in-salt electrolyte (WISE) or hydrate-melt electrolytes. The salt-in-water electrolyte refers to traditional aqueous electrolyte.

span.label: Grotthuss proton conduction —distinct-from→ conduction of metal ions
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — Stated flatly - `highly varying from` - not hedged, so weight 1.0.
span.quote: The motion process is highly varying from the conduction of metal ions where solvated metal ions diffuse at long distance individually. As a consequence, the battery based on the so-called Grotthuss proton conduction exhibited excellent rate performance

span.label: Grotthuss proton conduction —causes→ proton batteries
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.7 — `It is suggested that` - the paper hedges the attribution, so weight 0.7 records the paper's own caution, not mine.
span.quote: It is suggested that the diffusion-free Grotthuss topochemistry is the key to this superior rate performance of proton batteries.

span.label: electrochemical stability window —causes→ operating voltage
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — `would suppress` - asserted, but modally, hence 0.9 rather than 1.0.
span.quote: The narrow electrochemical stability window (ESW) of water would suppress the operating voltage
